visual_argument: One floodlit weigh station at night where a driverless tractor makes the scale house call itself, and the same company's own letter measured at one scale beside it. Anything Aurora says will happen but has not is laid in rust, so a reader can tell what exists from what is planned without the caption.
build_risk: Frame 2 needs every chassis model at once (truck_scale, scale_house, scale_signal, flood_pole) seen from a high oblique that keeps the horizon in frame, with three decision marks registered to projected positions. The models can read as slabs from 20 m and a pale concrete apron can push the frame into the mid tones. The kit semi_truck carries the eye, the apron stays inside a tight pool and everything outside it is asphalt.
distinct_from_recent: No. 66 was a lastLight night street with an SDF dog and a plug grid relief read as a calendar; this is floodlit, concrete and steel, with no unit grid in plan. No. 65 was a dark lab interior with a primitive robot arm and a navy wall band; the only interior here is the kit cab, looking out. No. 64 was road paint reliefs in a mid tone brown; here asphalt sits near black and the only reliefs are a rule, two lengths and a map. No. 41 (October 3rd) shot the kit truck under a stormFront sky; this is night under one flood.
